info.title: MTPooL API
info.description: The public read-only view of the proxy pool: nodes, domains, Telegram links, bans and statistics. No credentials needed; node addresses are masked and measurement ids are never shown. The agent routes under `/api/v1/agent`, the bot routes under `/api/v1/me` and the admin routes under `/api/v1/admin` take a bearer token. Errors are application/problem+json with a stable `code`.

get.summary:
The CSRF token of the session the cookie belongs to, for a panel that was reloaded and lost
the one login returned. A bearer token has no session, so there is nothing to return.

200.description: The CSRF token of the session the cookie belongs to

204.description: Signed in with a bearer token, which has no session

200.description: Logged in: the session cookie is set and the CSRF token returned

429.description: Too many failed attempts from this address

204.description: Logged out; the session cookie is cleared

200.description: The settings document and `secrets`: for each secret whether a value is available (never the value)

requestBody.description: A partial settings document; `secrets` maps a secret name to a value or null

200.description: The new settings document and `secrets`

400.description: Unknown field or secret, wrong type (`bad_request`) or a value settings do not allow (`invalid_settings`); nothing was changed

200.description: The domains SRMD keeps and how many the queue needs
SRMD lets go of the domain
SRMD takes the domain
The sensors, DNS and the counters of the last days

Server-sent events: one `event: <kind>` frame per pool event with `id` and a JSON `data` line, and a `: keepalive` comment every 15 seconds. The `id` counts the frames of this registrar run; there is no replay. The answer carries `X-Accel-Buffering: no` so the proxy passes frames at once.

200.description: The release file

agent_version.description: The agent version from the rollout record; absent until the node has polled.

failed.description:
The conditions that do not hold now: `tcp`, `metrics`, `globalping`, `port`,
`heartbeat_stale`, `report_stale`.

last_heartbeat.description: RFC 3339, UTC: the last heartbeat; absent if none came.

last_report_at.description:
RFC 3339, UTC: the last confirmed measurement; absent if none came since the node's last
new check began.

owner_name.description: Absent when the owner is gone.

AdminNode.description: A node as the admin sees it: the public document and what stays out of the public one.

AdminRound.description: A sensor round with the evidence of its votes.

AdminVote.description: One sensor's vote in a round, with what it measured.

evidence.description: The sensor's own document, as stored.

reason.description: Why the sensor abstained; only for `abstain`.

AgentConfig.description: `GET /agent/config`: what the node's proxy has to be set up with.

antiscan.description: Whether the agent defends the port against active probing.

sni.description: The TLS domain the proxy pretends to be.

AuditEntry.description: An entry of the audit log.

detail.description: What changed. Never a secret: settings changes list field names only.

BanRecord.description:
One entry of the ban log. `reverify` entries record a failed attempt to lift a ban, not a
new ban: they carry no `lifetime_sec` and no `gap_sec`.

gap_sec.description: Seconds since the previous ban in the pool; `null` for the first one.

id.description: Pass the id of the last entry as `before` to get the next page.

ip.description: The address with the two middle octets hidden.

lifetime_sec.description: Seconds from the registration of the node to the ban; `null` once the node is gone.

votes.description: The votes that confirmed the ban.

ClientsMark.description: An event on the time axis of the chart. No node, no address: only when and what.

ClientsMarkKind.description: What an event mark on the chart stands for.

ClientsPoint.description: One point of the client history: the mean over one step.

at.description: RFC 3339, UTC: the start of the step.

domains.description: Clients of each domain that had a number in the step.

ClientsRange.description: The windows the client history can be asked for.

ClientsSeries.description: The client history over a range.

points.description: Oldest first. A step without samples has no point: a gap is not filled.

secret.description: The key deliveries are signed with. Generated when absent.

url.description:
`https` only, at most 2048 characters, a name (not an address) that resolves to public
addresses only.

Dc2Report.description: The check of the second Telegram data center.

Delivery.description: One delivery attempt series of an event to a webhook.

next_at.description: When the next attempt is due. RFC 3339, UTC.

DnsRecord.description: What the domain is set to resolve to.

values.description:
Addresses of an `A` record, with the two middle octets hidden, or the one target of a
`CNAME`.

last_error.description: The provider's message of the last failure.

token_set.description: Whether a Cloudflare token is stored.

unsynced_domains.description: Domains whose record in DNS differs from the wanted one.

Empty.description: An answer with nothing in it.

EmptyRequest.description: `POST /agent/heartbeat` and `POST /agent/retire`: nothing to say. An empty body is fine.

EnrollRequest.description: `POST /agent/enroll`. The address of the node is the one the request comes from.

name.description:
1 to 32 letters, digits and `._-`, starting and ending with a letter or digit. The
registrar adds `-` and five random characters to make the node id.

port.description: The port the proxy listens on.

EnrollResponse.description: The answer to a successful enrollment.

node_token.description: The bearer token of the node. Shown here once; only its hash is kept.

replaced.description:
The node that gave way to this one: another one on the same address or, if none, a silent
node of the same owner that was holding the last place.

reverify.description: The address was blocked: a decisive check decides whether the node may stay.

EventEntry.description: An entry of the event log.

GlobalpingCheck.description: The state of the Globalping check of a node.

oneOf.description: A measurement was made; the registrar verifies it under its own key.
No measurement this time (a 429 or an outage of the service). Not a failure.

reason.description: `rate_limited`, `unavailable`, `timeout`; anything else counts as no data.

GpReport.description: What the agent says about its Globalping check.

HostReport.description: The host the node runs on.

Intervals.description: How often the agent does each of its jobs, in seconds.

LastRound.description: The latest sensor round of a node. Evidence and measurement ids are not published.

reason.description:
Why the sensor abstained: `not_configured`, `key_rejected`, `unavailable`, `rate_limited`,
`timeout`, `unknown_answer` or `no_data`. Only for `abstain`.

from_client_total.description: Cumulative octets from clients, as the engine exports them.

scope.description: `pool:read` lets a bot token register pool-wide webhooks.

NewTokenCreated.description: The answer to `POST /admin/tokens`: the only time the value is shown.

token.description: Shown once; it cannot be read again.

NodeChecks.description: What the pool sees on a node right now.

NodeHistory.description: `GET /nodes/{id}/history`: the last 96 buckets of a node that have samples, oldest first.

bucket_sec.description: The length of one bucket in seconds (900).

NodeHistoryBucket.description: One bucket of the node history.

clients.description: The most clients seen in the bucket.

start.description: RFC 3339, UTC: the start of the bucket.

up.description: Samples of the bucket in which the node was up.

OwnNode.description: A node of the owner, with its full address.

oneOf.description: The latest sensor round; `null` when there was none.

state_since.description: When the node entered its current state. RFC 3339, UTC.

OwnerInfo.description: The owner a bot token belongs to.

node_limit.description: Most nodes the owner may have in the pool at once.

OwnerPatch.description: `PATCH /admin/owners/{id}`: the fields that are present change.

Problem.description:
What went wrong. `code` is the part clients branch on and never changes for a given
failure: `bad_request`, `unauthorized`, `forbidden`, `csrf`, `not_found`,
`method_not_allowed`, `rate_limited`, `internal`. `title` and `detail` are for people.

status.description: The HTTP status of the response.

type.description: A URI reference naming the problem type; `about:blank` when `code` says it all.

ProxyLink.description: A Telegram proxy link of one user on one domain.

qr_url.description: Path of the QR code of the link (SVG).

clients.description: Clients on the domain; absent while unknown.

oneOf.description: `null` while the domain has no DNS state yet.

dns_synced.description: Whether the record in DNS is the one the pool wants.

folded_into.description: The domain this one is folded into (it is a CNAME onto it); absent otherwise.

masters.description: The node ids that are masters of the domain.

availability_bp.description:
Uptime over the last 30 days in hundredths of a percent (9997 is 99.97 %). Absent while
the node has no samples.

checks.description: The conditions the pool watches on the node.

clients.description: Clients connected to the node, as its last report said; absent until it reported one.

domains.description: The domains the node is master of.

ip.description: The address with the two middle octets hidden.

is_master.description: Whether the node is the master of at least one domain.

oneOf.description: The latest sensor round. Only in the answer for a single node.

master_since.description: For a master: since when it has been master (its earliest slot start, RFC 3339, UTC).

next_round_at.description: When the next sensor round of the node is due (RFC 3339, UTC).

quarantine_reasons.description:
Why the node entered quarantine: `tcp`, `metrics`, `globalping`, `port`, `heartbeat_stale`,
`report_stale` (no confirmed measurement for too long). Absent in other states.

queue_position.description:
Place in the queue for a master slot, from 1: only for a healthy node that is not a
master.

rotates_at.description:
For a master: when its slot is due to rotate (RFC 3339, UTC). Absent when rotation is
off.

state_since.description: When the node entered its current state. RFC 3339, UTC.

RecentBan.description: A ban in the activity feed.

checked_at.description:
When the agent made the checks, RFC 3339. Must be within 10 minutes before and one
minute after the registrar's clock.

error.description: What went wrong on the node, if something did.

ip.description: The address the measurement was made against. Must be the registered one.

sni.description: The TLS domain the measurement used.

RolloutCounts.description: How many nodes are at each stage.

at.description: RFC 3339: when the node entered the stage (absent for `idle`).

code.description: With `failed`: the code the agent or the registrar gave.

version.description: The agent version the node last reported; absent until it has polled.

RolloutNote.description: The note of a rollout that waits or is paused: why, in a code and in words for the admin.

RolloutTimings.description: The timings a rollout runs by; copied from the settings when it starts.

RolloutView.description: A rollout of an agent release: `GET /admin/rollouts` and `/admin/rollouts/{id}`.

can_cancel.description: Whether `POST .../cancel` is accepted (the rollout is not over).

can_resume.description: Whether `POST .../resume` is accepted (the rollout is paused).

changed_at.description: RFC 3339: when the rollout was paused, finished or cancelled.

next_batch_at.description: RFC 3339: when the next batch goes out (`batches`).

oneOf.description: Why the rollout waits or is paused; absent while it runs.

observing_since.description: RFC 3339: when the canary is judged good (`observing`: its start; add `observe_sec`).

phase.description:
`canary` (one node takes it; waits without a candidate), `observing` (the canary is
watched), `batches`, `paused`, `done` or `cancelled`.

resume_to.description: With `paused`: the phase "continue" goes back to (`canary`, `observing`, `batches`).

version.description: The release version being rolled out.

last_answer_at.description: RFC 3339, UTC: the last time the sensor gave an answer other than an abstention.

last_reason.description: Why the last vote was an abstention.

SessionCsrf.description: What the panel sends back in `X-CSRF-Token` on every change.

cnames.description: Folded domain to the one it points to.

folded.description: Domains that are folded into another.

needed.description: How many domains the queue needs now.

start_ts.description: RFC 3339, UTC: the start of the bucket.

StatsPoint.description: Numbers of one stretch of time: the whole range (`kpi`) or one bucket of the series.

avg_gap_sec.description:
Mean seconds since the previous ban over those bans that have a previous one; `null`
when there is none.

avg_lifetime_sec.description:
Mean seconds from the registration to the ban over those of them whose node is still
known; `null` when there is none.

bans.description: Bans that began in the stretch.

traffic_egress_bytes.description: Bytes from the nodes to clients.

traffic_ingress_bytes.description: Bytes from clients to the nodes.

StatsRange.description: The windows the statistics can be asked for.

StatsSeries.description: Figures per bucket over a range.

buckets.description: From `from` on, `step_sec` apart; the last one is still running.

by_reason.description:
Bans by the sensors that confirmed them: the names of the sensors that voted
`blocked`, sorted and joined by `+` (`cheburcheck+globalping`).

from.description: RFC 3339, UTC: the start of the range, aligned down to a step.

history_ok.description: Whether the stored history reaches back to `from` (traffic is kept for 35 days).

now.description: RFC 3339, UTC: when the figures were computed.

StatusCounts.description: Counts of things that happened lately.

Terminate.description:
The body of a 403 to a node that is out of the pool: it stops its proxy and, if the reason
allows, enrolls again.

TokenInfo.description: The token a request was made with. The token itself is never shown.

prefix.description: The first characters of the token, to tell tokens apart.

scope.description: Extra rights of the token (`pool:read`); empty for none.

TokenMeta.description: A token as the admin sees it: never the value, never the hash.

node_id.description: The node of a `node` token. The token goes with the node's record.

version.description:
The version to update to, or absent when the node is not asked to update. The agent
fetches `/releases/manifest.json` and checks the signature itself; this is only the
registrar's wish.

UpdateOutcome.description: What happened to the update on the node.

UpdatePoll.description: `POST /agent/update`: the agent says which version it runs and asks whether to update.

version.description: The version the agent runs, `x.y.z` with an optional `-pre` part.

UpdateStatus.description:
`POST /agent/update-status`: the agent reports an update step. It is sent again until the
registrar answers, so a report may repeat.

code.description:
Required with `failed`: a short code of 1 to 40 characters `a-z`, `0-9`, `_`
(`bad_signature`, `bad_hash`, `downgrade`, `key_mismatch`, `download`, `start_failed`).

version.description: The version the update is about.

Vote.description: What one sensor said in a round.

Webhook.description: A webhook subscription. The secret is not part of it.

WebhookCreated.description: The answer to `POST /me/webhooks`: the only time the secret is shown.

secret.description: Shown once; it cannot be read again.

status.description: `pending`: the sender delivers it like any other event.

bearer.description: `mtp_enroll_...` to enroll and `mtp_node_...` for the rest of the agent routes; `mtp_bot_...` for `/me`; `mtp_admin_...` for `/admin`

tags.name: agent
tags.description: Routes of the node agent; they need a node token, enrollment an enroll token

tags.name: bot
tags.description: Routes of an owner's bot; they need a bot token (`mtp_bot_...`)

tags.name: admin
tags.description: Routes of the panel and the admin; they need the admin token (`mtp_admin_...`) or a panel session
